{"reason":"Add the missing high-confidence condition and tighten materiality/exposure to 0.2 and 1,000,000. This excludes low-confidence false positives (0.60–0.67), the 0.194/680,000 case, and the -0.428/690,000/0.91 case, reducing v1’s 71.4% false-arbitration rate while targeting recall ≥0.8.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.2)
       (> inventory-exposure 1000000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
